messages:
Elaine (PM): kicking off design partner recruitment for the Dedicated Autoscale beta. goal: 6 partners (mix of startup + mid-market + 1 enterprise). pilot window: 6 weeks, target start week of Apr 7. need CS/sales help with nominations.
Sam (Eng): awesome. can we lock acceptance criteria? also need to know what infra configs we’ll expose (min/max GPUs, burst, preemptible?).
Elaine (PM): yes — acceptance criteria draft below. open to tweaks:
- partner deploys workload to dedicated pool
- observes 20% cost reduction or 3x throughput for same latency budget
- integrates with our rollout APIs and traces
- provides 10 prompt/eval pairs for quality monitoring
Priyanka (CS): I'll pull 8 candidate accounts from customers with high token volume and existing dedicated interest. prefer those with webhooks enabled.
Michael (Design): want to run 2 UX sessions (screen share + 30m) during week 2 to capture onboarding friction. will prepare a short task script.
Oliver (Research): we should capture these metrics per partner: p50/p90 token latency, tokens/sec, cost per 1k tokens, model quality drift (eval score). will produce eval harness.
Elaine (PM): outreach template in the recruitment doc: <https://docs.google.com/example-recruitment|recruitment doc> — please edit with customer names. sample snippet below:
```
Hi NAME,
We'd love to invite you to a short beta of Redwood Dedicated Autoscale. Benefits: predictable bursts, lower token cost, and config-level control. 6-week pilot, reserved support + $X credit. Interested? Reply and we can set a demo.
```
Priyanka (CS): suggestion: offer 3 months free Dedicated credits and SLT onboarding session. motivates enterprise sign-up.
Jessica (Legal): note — need NDA + data processing addendum signoff before access. can pre-send an LP NDA; allow 48h turnaround.
Elaine (PM): agreed. Jessica, can you prepare a one-page summary + sample NDA for outreach by EOD Friday?
Jessica (Legal): yes. I’ll share doc link and a short checklist (PII/no access, logs retention, KMS options).
dp-bot: New doc created: "dp-beta-recruitment-playbook" by Elaine (PM) — <https://docs.google.com/example-recruitment|open>
Sam (Eng): operational asks: we need a stable canary image, feature flags for autoscale, and a telemetry dashboard template (per-tenant). also define rollback triggers.
Oliver (Research): rollback triggers proposal: >5% error rate increase OR >10% latency regression sustained for 5m. keep threshold conservative for first partners.
Michael (Design): also capture onboarding time (minutes to get model online) and number of manual infra tweaks required.
Elaine (PM): timeline check: week 0 recruit & NDAs; week 1 onboarding + baseline eval; weeks 2–5 run pilot with weekly syncs; week 6 wrap + tech transfer doc. launch criteria: 4/6 partners meet acceptance + no P0s in last 2 weeks.
Priyanka (CS): I'll send an initial list of 10 names by EOD tomorrow. will add a short qualification note for each.
Sam (Eng): engineering can support 3 onboarding sessions per week. need partner access (VPN/keys) 48h before scheduled onboarding.
Elaine (PM): communications plan: weekly pilot digest to partners + internal 30m sync every Fri. shared channel for realtime issues.
Jessica (Legal): quick reminder: if partner wants to test on-prem variant, separate legal review needed. flag early.
Oliver (Research): suggest we add a small automated eval harness partners run on their own traffic (opt-in) — returns quality deltas to us. privacy-minded by design.
Elaine (PM): final asks for this thread: (1) Priyanka — list of names, (2) Jessica — NDA + checklist, (3) Sam — telemetry dashboard template, (4) Michael — UX task script. I'll assemble outreach next.
Priyanka (CS): sending list now.
Sam (Eng): will drop dashboard template in the doc and add runbook for common failures.
Michael (Design): task script shared in doc, will iterate after first two sessions.
Elaine (PM): perfect. let's reconvene Tue 10am to finalize invites. thanks everyone :rocket:
